''"''I never intended to take the ''Falcon'' against a Death Star. I was just giving Lando a lift to Kessel.''"''
''"''Think of it as an added bonus|Mara Jade asking Han Solo to help lead the attack against the Death Star prototype|}} A '''battle''' was fought above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] from the nearby [[Maw Installation]] and the [[Smugglers' Alliance]]. ==The battle== ===Prelude=== {{Quote|Attention, everyone! Hurry with those repairs. I want to destroy something as soon as possible.|Tol Sivron to his crew|}} After the Smugglers' Alliance took control of Kessel and its [[Garrison Moon|moon]] from [[Moruth Doole]] in 11 ABY, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], accompanied by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], arrived and met with Alliance member [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Calrissian had recently gained a large sum of money and was looking to invest in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining operations on the planet. Not long after the trio met and discussed Calrissian's purchase, the [[Death Star prototype]] arrived, having escaped a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of the Maw|attack]] on the nearby Imperial research facility, Maw Installation. Onboard was [[Tol Sivron]] and most of the installation's personnel. ===The space battle=== {{Dialogue|Mara Jade|Warning! We've detected a large vessel approaching Kessel—and I mean large.|Han Solo|Lando, check the scanners.|Lando Calrissian|Not just large, it's the Death Star.|attr=Mara, Han, and Lando notice the Death Star prototype on the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} scanners|src=}} As soon as the Death Star was spotted, the Alliance ships stationed on the moon began launching to attack the prototype. Sivron planned to determine the Death Star's destructive capabilities by test firing its [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] on Kessel, claiming that it might as well have been a Rebel base. The Death Star fired but, due to its poor calibration, hit the Garrison Moon instead. Although the moon housed the Alliance's ships, only three were destroyed when the moon exploded; the rest having already launched. The prototype began firing its superlaser at the oncoming [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] ships, but only succeeded in destroying one, as the remainder were small and fast enough to avoid the blast. The battle quickly turned into a stalemate, as the prototype's superlaser was too inaccurate and charged too slowly to take out the freighters, and the freighters themselves lacked the firepower to cause any serious damage to the prototype. Realizing that their best chance was to wait for help from the New Republic to arrive, the Smugglers' Alliance forces pulled back to regroup, and Sivron used this as an opportunity to return to the Maw. Just before it was able to leave, the ''Falcon'', with Solo, Calrissian, and Jade onboard, secretly secured itself onto the prototype using its landing claw, and accompanied it on its journey back. The ''Falson''{{'s}} crew subsequently attempted to detonate the prototype's [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]], but only succeeded in causing minor damage. ===Aftermath=== {{Quote|You know, this is all kind of beautiful in its own way.|Lando Calrissian on the Garrison Moon's debris raining down on Kessel|}} The Smugglers' Alliance had been planning to use the Garrison Moon as a base for their mining operations, so the destruction of it was a major setback for them. The moon's destruction also bombarded Kessel with debris, although most of the planet's installations were subterranean, meaning that it proved a relatively small setback. Lando, though upset at the moon's destruction, later considered the raining debris somewhat beautiful. The Death Star prototype returned to the Maw, where the arrival of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Gorgon]]'', was turning the tide of the battle in favor of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Champions of the Force]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' *''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'' *[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] *{{FactFile|85|ACA 1-4|Founding the New Jedi Academy}} *''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{GCW Daala}} {{Interlang |de=Zweite Schlacht von Kessel (11 NSY) |es=Batalla de Kessel (11 DBY) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kessel (11 ABY), battle of}} [[Category:Artificial disasters]] [[Category:Battles of Kessel]] [[Category:Battles of the Daala campaign]]
